title: Open Relationship
summary: An open relationship is one where partners agree that they can have sexual or romantic connections with others. It depends on clear rules, honesty and ongoing consent.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
